analysis:
Reviewed GLM-5.3-Flash prompt/output-contract changes against the A-001/TB-007 request-plaintext handling and the T-008 fail-closed expectations. No security regression was identified.

GLM5NextResponseFormat.swift (new): resolve (lines 21-44) refuses JSON response_format combined with tools. It compiles json_schema with the existing fail-closed compiler. validatedContent (lines 49-69) withholds the answer and returns fixed 422 messages that never echo generated content. It rejects a root number truncated at finish_reason length. GLM5NextResponseFormatOutput.withholding (lines 90-102) buffers content but streams reasoning, plus toolCall and info events. Tool calls cannot arise because tools are refused at line 29. The buffer is request-local and bounded by the generation budget.

ToolChoicePromptPolicy.swift (head lines 15-16 and 34): attaches glmResponseFormat to every prepared request, gated by the GLM model type.

GLM5NextPromptPolicy.swift:
- withholdsOutput (head lines 24-26) is new.
- Reasoning controls are parsed strictly (lines 104-256). Contradictory or unknown values fail closed.
- Returned reasoning from consumer history (lines 117-120 and 415-431) is replayed only into that same request's template. It is applied only when it aligns with the messages. This is the consumer's own prompt, so no cross-tenant flow arises. It is subject to the same prefix-cache scoping as other prompt content (T-041/SEC-035 unchanged).

ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.swift: GLM uses structuredPostValidation (head lines 54-58). Forced choice is supported only for managed GLM model IDs (lines 82-88). The native .glm5 parser format is required (lines 165-171).

Integration questions (callers not supplied):
- Confirm the engine and streaming path actually consult withholdsOutput and validatedAnswer. Unvalidated JSON or forced-call content must not be streamed before validation.
- Confirm media paths refuse GLM forced choice and JSON format as the comments claim.
- Confirm that GLM5NextCoordinatorServing.isManagedModelID derives from provider-owned metadata.
